answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 43056 Country: United States of America Title: What are the meanings of Muhammad Ridwanul Alam and Namir, Jarir, Affan, Fawzaan Question: What are the meanings of Muhammad Ridwanul Alam and Namir, Jarir, Affan, Fawzaan? Answer ID: 43056 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 60/60/M=1434) Rizwan: the name of the yeoman of Jannah, pleasing Namir: clear water, pure Affan: modest Fauzan: successful Jarir: rope on camel, one who pulls Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
